notes.title: Sealed Bite: Extended has a dedicated Discord!
notes.notes:
Hey all! 

We're thrilled to let you know that Sealed Bite: Extended now has an official Discord server! 

If
* you like Sealed Bite 
* you want to connect with the dev team and other players
* you played the DEMO and you'd like to share your feedback
* you want to be the first to read all announcements
* you want to know some more about the development
and much more! 

[url=https://discord.gg/Z5fnQYK65d][b]Join our Discord! [/b][/url]
We want to see everyone in there! 

Also, there's a [b]DEMO[/b] that you can play if you haven't yet 😉
We'd love to see you give it a go! 
You're more than welcome to share your playthroughs with us as well.

The invite link is now also available in the discussion section as a pinned topic. 
We can't wait to see you!

notes.title: Sealed Bite: Extended DEMO is OUT!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We’re happy to announce that the [b]DEMO for Sealed Bite: Extended is OUT NOW![/b] 

We'd love to see you give it a go and if you do... we want to hear about it! 
Your feedback is super important to us, but we'd also love to connect with everyone! 


How to Share Feedback:
[olist]
[*] Leave a comment in the community section
[*] Join the discussion threads
[/olist]

Also, we've just started out Twitter account and we'd appreciate leaving us a follow on there. It will help us spread the word about Sealed Bite and connect with more people.

[b]Twitter[/b] >> https://x.com/SealedBite


Last but not least, don’t forget to add Sealed Bite: Extended to your wishlist to stay in the loop for all future updates.
Thanks for your support! 

Happy adventuring! 🐺✨
